definition: σπίλος (Rec. σπῖλος), -ου, ὁ  __1. a rock, cliff (Arist., al.).  __2. In late writers = Att.. κηλίς (see Rutherford, NPhr., 87 f.), a spot, stain; metaphorically,  __(a) of moral blemish: Eph.5:27  __(b) of riotous and lascivious persons (cf. Dion. Hal., quoted by Mayor, in l): 2Pe.2:13.† (AS)
